import json, re, collections
mig = open('supabase/migrations/20260906010000_policies_follow_get_my_role_name.sql', encoding='utf-8').read()
cap = json.load(open('docs/validation/get-my-role-policies.json', encoding='utf-8'))

# executable body only
body = mig[mig.index('BEGIN;'):mig.index('COMMIT;')]
print("executable body checks")
print("  ALTER POLICY   :", len(re.findall(r'\bALTER\s+POLICY\b', body)))
print("  DROP POLICY    :", len(re.findall(r'\bDROP\s+POLICY\b', body)))
print("  CREATE POLICY  :", len(re.findall(r'\bCREATE\s+POLICY\b', body)))
print("  ' TO '         :", len(re.findall(r'\sTO\s+\w', body)))
print("  get_my_role()  :", len(re.findall(r'get_my_role\(\)', body)))
print("  ::user_role    :", len(re.findall(r'::user_role', body)))

EXPAND = {
    frozenset(['admin','chairman','financial_secretary']): {'super_admin','chairman','vice_chairman','financial_officer'},
    frozenset(['admin','chairman']):                        {'super_admin','chairman','vice_chairman'},
    frozenset(['admin']):                                   {'super_admin'},
    frozenset(['admin','chairman','financial_secretary','security_officer']): {'super_admin','chairman','vice_chairman','financial_officer','security_officer'},
    frozenset(['security_officer']):                        {'security_officer'},
}
# split body into per-statement chunks keyed by (table, policy)
stmts = re.split(r'(?=ALTER\s+POLICY)', body)
stmts = [s for s in stmts if s.strip().startswith('ALTER POLICY')]
seen = {}
for s in stmts:
    m = re.search(r'ALTER\s+POLICY\s+"?(.+?)"?\s+ON\s+(?:public\.)?(\w+)', s, re.S)
    assert m, s[:120]
    seen[(m.group(2), m.group(1))] = s

print("\nparsed statements:", len(seen))
capmap = {(p['tablename'], p['policyname']): p for p in cap['policies']}
print("capture policies  :", len(capmap))
print("  missing from migration:", len(set(capmap) - set(seen)))
print("  invented in migration :", len(set(seen) - set(capmap)))

groups = collections.Counter()
bad = []
for key, p in capmap.items():
    s = seen.get(key)
    if s is None: continue
    old = set(re.findall(r"'([a-z_]+)'::user_role", p['qual'] + ' ' + p['with_check']))
    want = EXPAND.get(frozenset(old))
    got = set(re.findall(r"'([a-z_]+)'::text", s))
    if want is None:
        bad.append((key, 'unknown legacy set', old)); continue
    groups[tuple(sorted(want))] += 1
    if got != want:
        bad.append((key, sorted(want), sorted(got)))

print("\nexpansion groups actually produced:")
for g, n in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    print(f"  {n:3}  {', '.join(g)}")
print("\nMISMATCHES:", len(bad))
for b in bad[:8]: print("   ", b)
vc = sum(1 for k,p in capmap.items() if 'vice_chairman' in (EXPAND.get(frozenset(re.findall(r"'([a-z_]+)'::user_role", p['qual']+' '+p['with_check'])), set())))
print("\npolicies that MUST contain vice_chairman:", vc)
print("statements that DO contain vice_chairman:", sum(1 for s in seen.values() if 'vice_chairman' in s))
